data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'dardanos', which means 'firm, steadfast, or enduring'. In Greek mythology, Dardanos was the founder of the city of Dardanelles and a descendant of Zeus. This name embodies courage and strength, making it an excellent choice for a little girl.
